intro: {{nameA}} in {{cityA}} and {{nameB}} in {{cityB}} are two {{course}} options students often weigh together. This page compares their recorded fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Amity Noida vs Noida International University is not a single winner. Amity Noida has a recorded NIRF 2024 #39, and Noida International University has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: Amity Noida vs Noida International University for Integrated Law: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity Noida if you want a recorded NIRF 2024 #39, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, in a private Integrated Law setting at Noida.
Choose Noida International University if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹90,000, in a private Integrated Law setting at Greater Noida.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹2.64 lakh as a tuition figure for BA.LLB (HONS) at Amity Noida. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹90,000 as a programme total for BA.LLB (HONS) at Noida International University.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amity Noida's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹14 LPA on BA.LLB (HONS). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Noida International University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on BA.LLB (HONS). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Amity Noida is listed on our records with CLAT as an admission route for this Integrated Law comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Noida International University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Amity Noida is in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh, and Noida International University is in {{cityB}}, Uttar Pradesh. A move between these cities should be part of the decision, not only the fee or the rank.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Amity Noida's recorded ₹2.64 lakh or Noida International University's ₹90,000 fits your budget for this Integrated Law.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Noida International University's recorded ₹90,000 or Amity Noida's ₹2.64 lakh fits your budget for this Integrated Law.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity Noida or Noida International University?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Amity Noida and Noida International University differ in more than one way: Amity Noida has a recorded NIRF 2024 #39, and Noida International University has no NIRF rank on this page.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Amity Noida vs Noida International University?

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Amity Noida and Noida International University?

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Amity Noida and Noida International University accept?

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
